book.name: MATEO
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U TIO Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Mateo tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Nichuk u txꞌiꞌlanaj txumbꞌal tiꞌ uvaꞌ la paavin u Jesús
As bꞌen veꞌt u Jesúseꞌ tu u tzuukin txꞌavaꞌeꞌ taꞌn u Tiixhla Espíritueꞌ, tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ichuk u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ txumbꞌal tiꞌ ipaavin u Jesúseꞌ.
As kaꞌviinqil qꞌii tukꞌ kaꞌviinqit aqꞌbꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌl u Jesúseꞌ nikat itxꞌaꞌneꞌ. As vaꞌy veꞌt Aak.
As ul veꞌt u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ kꞌatz u Jesúseꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —Asoj axh iKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ, as ala uvaꞌ la bꞌen unqꞌa kꞌubꞌeꞌ txꞌixil,— tiꞌk u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ.
Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Ech ni tal viyol u Tiixh ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: Jit kuxh u txꞌixeꞌ la isbꞌaꞌn unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
Pet kajayil chit unqꞌa yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni tel chꞌuꞌl titziꞌ u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ uveꞌ la isbꞌaꞌn unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.

content: As bꞌen veꞌt u Jesúseꞌ taꞌn u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ tu u tenam uvaꞌ txaael taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ Jerusalén. As jeꞌ veꞌt Aak viꞌ u tostiixheꞌ taꞌn u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ.
As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —Asoj axh viKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ, as suti kuꞌ eebꞌ tzitzaꞌ, tan ech ni tal u yol ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: La ichaj tzan u Tiixheꞌ unqꞌa ángel tiꞌ ul ilochat axh.
As la ul ikꞌul axh unqꞌa ángel aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la kꞌaxbꞌu veꞌt avoj tiꞌ umaj u kꞌubꞌ,— tiꞌk u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ.

content: Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Ech ni tal viyol u Tiixh ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: Yeꞌ la uch abꞌekꞌat u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ,—

content: tiꞌk Aak.

As bꞌen veꞌt u Jesúseꞌ viꞌ umaꞌl u nimla vitz taꞌn u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ. As ikꞌuch veꞌt u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ te u Jesúseꞌ jankꞌal unqꞌa veeꞌ at tulaj unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ as tukꞌ unqꞌa itxꞌiibꞌal iqꞌii unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil.
As ech tal naj ileꞌ: —Asoj la kuꞌ axh qaaloj sunvatz tiꞌ ooksat unqꞌii, as la vaqꞌ unqꞌa veeꞌ see skajayil,— tiꞌk u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ.
Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Jetzꞌen el sunvatz, txꞌiꞌlanaj, tan ech ni tal umaꞌt u yol ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: Taꞌn kuxh u Tiixheꞌ, u Kubꞌaaleꞌ, la kuꞌ axh qaaloj svatz.

content: tiꞌk u Jesúseꞌ.
As taqꞌ veꞌt kan u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ u Jesúseꞌ. As ul veꞌt kaꞌl unqꞌa ángel kꞌatz Aak tiꞌ ilochpu veꞌt Aak.
Nixeꞌt u Jesús chusun tu u Galilea
As tul tabꞌi veꞌt u Jesúseꞌ yol uvaꞌ maꞌtik tok veꞌt u Xhuneꞌ tu u kaarsa, as qꞌaav veꞌt Aak tu u Galilea.
As taqꞌ veꞌt kan Aak u Nazaret. As aꞌ bꞌexkat veꞌt Aak jejebꞌoj tu u Capernaúm uvaꞌ echen tziꞌ u nimla naabꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ atikkat vitxꞌavaꞌ u Zabulón tukꞌ u Neftalí.
As bꞌex ibꞌan veꞌt u yoleꞌ uveꞌ alelik kan taꞌn u Isaías, u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ, uvaꞌ ech nik tal ileꞌ:

content.text: Unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ jejleꞌl tu vitxꞌavaꞌ u Zabulón tukꞌ tu vitxꞌavaꞌ u Neftalí,
tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ echen najlich u nimla bꞌeyeꞌ uvaꞌ yakleꞌl tziꞌ u mareꞌ,
tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ echen jalit u Jordán,
as tukꞌ unqꞌa jit tiaal Israel uvaꞌ jejleꞌl tu u Galilea,
as aꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ eyen u taanxelaleꞌ tu u qꞌej toktoeꞌ.
As la til veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ umaꞌl u txijun tetz u taanxelaleꞌ uvaꞌ nim talcheꞌ.
As jankꞌal unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ at tzan u kamchileꞌ stiꞌ, as la txijul veꞌteꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ uveꞌ tal kan u Isaías.

content: Tul kat oon veꞌt u Jesús tu u Capernaúm, as xeꞌt veꞌt Aak tiꞌ talat viyol u Tiixheꞌ. As ech nik tal Aak ileꞌ: —¡Ekꞌaxataj vepaaveꞌ! Tan il u Tiixh ileꞌ tul veꞌteꞌ tukꞌ u tijleꞌmeꞌ tiꞌ vitenameꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
Tul nik ixaan u Jesús tziꞌ u mar tu u Galilea, as til veꞌt Aak u Simón uvaꞌ Luꞌ, tukꞌ u titzꞌineꞌ uvaꞌ Lixh. As nik isuti bꞌen chajnaj vikꞌacheꞌ xeꞌ u mar, tan txeyol txay chajnaj.
As ech tal u Jesús ileꞌ te chajnaj: —Xekebꞌoj ex sviꞌ. As la voksa veꞌt ex tiꞌ uvaꞌ la eteqꞌo tzan unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ tok sunkꞌatz,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As yak kuxh taqꞌ veꞌt kan chajnaj unqꞌa ikꞌacheꞌ. As xekebꞌ veꞌt chajnaj tiꞌ u Jesús.

Bꞌiil kuxh ixaa u Jesús. As bꞌex ilej Aak kaꞌvaꞌt unqꞌa txeyol txay uvaꞌ titzꞌin tibꞌ, tukꞌ u Jacobo tukꞌ u Xhun, vikꞌaol u Zebedeo. As xonlik kuxh chajnaj tukꞌ vibꞌaaleꞌ tu u barco, tan nikat kuxh ikꞌooa chajnaj unqꞌa ikꞌacheꞌ. As imolo veꞌt u Jesús chajnaj.
As yak kuxh taqꞌ veꞌt kan chajnaj vibꞌaaleꞌ tukꞌ u barco. As xekebꞌ veꞌt chajnaj tiꞌ u Jesús.

As bꞌex veꞌt u Jesús chusun tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh, tulaj unqꞌa talaj tenameꞌ tu u Galilea skajayil. As nikat tal u Jesús isuuchil u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ la ul veꞌt tukꞌ u tijleꞌmeꞌ tiꞌ vitenameꞌ. As nikat ibꞌaꞌnxisa veꞌt Aak unqꞌa aachꞌoꞌmeꞌ skajayil, kꞌuxh kam kuxh chꞌoꞌmil.

As pax veꞌt itzibꞌlal Aak tulaj unqꞌa tenameꞌ tu u Siria. As mamaꞌla aachꞌoꞌm eqꞌol tzan vatz Aak. As ati uvaꞌ subꞌul atik ok skꞌatz. As ati uvaꞌ chꞌuꞌjil elnallukat. As ati uvaꞌ yeꞌ nikat itxꞌol itiin vichiꞌoleꞌ. As kat ibꞌaꞌnxisa veꞌt u Jesús skajayil.
As mamaꞌla tenam xekelik tiꞌ Aak. As xekelik unqꞌa aa Galilea tukꞌ unqꞌa aa Decápolis, tukꞌ unqꞌa aa Jerusalén, tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa aa Judea, as tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ jalit u Jordán.
